speaker: Doctor

DIAGNOSIS READY: Ovarian Malignancy (likely Epithelial Ovarian Cancer) with secondary Pulmonary Embolism and Malignant Ascites.

The normal thrombophilia panel suggests your clot is secondary to the tumor-induced hypercoagulable state, while the right ventricular strain confirms the pulmonary embolism is significant. We need to prioritize anticoagulation for the clot and plan for surgical resection of the ovarian mass to treat the underlying cancer.
